answer.reason: The verses tell how the mercy seat was made, that God spoke from above it, and that the high priest sprinkled blood on it.

clauses.english: was made of pure gold, with two cherubim of beaten gold on its ends
clauses.quote: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold

clauses.english: was where the LORD spoke with Moses from between the two cherubim
clauses.quote: heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat

clauses.english: was sprinkled with the blood of the bullock and of the goat
clauses.quote: sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward
